title: A Proof of Bala's Congruence Conjectures for A158690
summary: Let $a(n)$ be the sequence A158690 in the On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences (OEIS), defined by the exponential generating function $\sum_{n\ge0} a(n)t^n/n! = 1+\sum_{m\ge1}\prod_{j=1}^m(1-e^{-(2j-1)t})$. We prove two congruence conjectures of Peter Bala. The first states that, for every integer $k\ge1$, the sequence $a(n)$ modulo $k$ is eventually periodic with period dividing $\varphi(k)$.
